reader.requirement: At --std 85 a READ of a relative file in sequential access mode must be Format 1 (READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [AT END] [NOT AT END] [END-READ]); Format 2's INVALID KEY / NOT INVALID KEY phrases, a KEY phrase, and the 2002 PREVIOUS and lock phrases are refused on such a file.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Year >= 2002 returns early: the 1985 requirement that a dynamic-access sequential READ write NEXT (SR3) applies at 85 only; not reached for sequential access
InForce = Edition.Year < 2002: at 85 AT END or INVALID KEY is mandatory without an applicable USE procedure (SR5)
EditionContext.Removed: an error under strict, a warning under --permissive (not an edition switch; same at 85 and 2023)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 the 2002 phrases PREVIOUS and WITH LOCK are refused (COBOL0900) and the SR5 exception-phrase requirement applies; the Format-1/Format-2 screen itself is the same code at 85 and 2023 (rrbad1 COBOL1720 and rrbad5 COBOL2269 at both)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f21_03 and g85_f21_08 run Format 1 READs on sequential relative files; the refusal of INVALID KEY, NOT INVALID KEY, KEY, PREVIOUS, lock phrases and AT END mixed with INVALID KEY on such a file is not exercised

probes.printed: 1 AAAA RK=01 / 2 BBBB RK=02 / 3 AT END / 4 AAAA ST=00 / USE ST=10 / 5 ST=10
probes.expected: READ NEXT RECORD AT END, READ RECORD INTO ... AT END ... NOT AT END, and a phrase-less READ under a USE procedure on sequential-access relative files read in relative-number order, update the relative key, and take AT END / the USE procedure at end of file

probes.printed: error COBOL1720: the INVALID KEY phrase shall not be specified for a READ statement that references a file whose READ is a Format-1 sequential read
probes.expected: Format 2 phrase on sequential access refused

probes.printed: error COBOL1720 (NOT INVALID KEY) and COBOL6826 (no AT END, no USE: §1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR5)
error COBOL0864: READ KEY on 'RLF': the KEY phrase may be specified only when ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
probes.expected: the 1985 relative READ has no KEY phrase; refused

probes.printed: error COBOL2269: READ INVALID KEY: no general format of the READ statement prints the INVALID KEY phrase beside the AT END phrase

probes.expected: READ RLF NEXT AT END is Format 1; accepted

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: READ PREVIOUS requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: PREVIOUS is not in the 1985 format

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: a record-lock phrase ... requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: WITH LOCK is not in the 1985 format

reader.notes: KeyedIoBinder.BindRead binds a sequential-access relative READ as ReadKind.Next and screens the Format 2 INVALID KEY bracket through ScreenForbiddenPhrase (COBOL1720), the KEY phrase through CheckReadKeyOrganization, and a mixed bracket at the phrase-association parse (COBOL2269). Under --permissive the INVALID KEY screen becomes a warning with the phrase dead; the default strict compile refuses.

refuter.evidence: §1985:VIII.4.5.2 Format 1 vs Format 2 differ only in NEXT/AT END vs INVALID KEY. Probes at --std 85: rr1 relative file with NO ACCESS clause (default sequential) READ INVALID KEY -> COBOL1720; rr2 GLOBAL relative FD read from a nested program with INVALID KEY / NOT INVALID KEY -> COBOL1720; rr3 EXTERNAL FD with INVALID KEY -> COBOL1720 (plus SR1 COBOL6827 for INTO the record area); rr4 positive: READ RLF RECORD END ... NOT END and READ RLF END (AT omitted) run, printed AAAA / E2. Reader covered PREVIOUS, lock, KEY and mixed phrases. cite.py: OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR2  (4.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2.
